text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for waiting. Please go ahead

text_block_list.text: It's Ruby!
choice_data_list:
Wait, looks like they're in the middle of 
an interview

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"You finished 5th in the recent Japanese 
Oaks. What are your honest thoughts on 
that, Ruby-san?"

"Daiichi Ruby had announced her entry into 
the Tiara route. Due to her lineage, she 
drew immense expectations and attention, 
but—"

Unable to run in the Oka Sho despite high 
expectations, she ended up finishing in 
5th place at the Yushun Himba (Oaks) as 
the 2nd favorite.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I accept the result for what it is. I have 
identified the issues, so I will have them 
resolved before the next race.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
If I may offer my assessment, it appeared 
that she ran out of stamina in the second 
half.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Stamina is certainly a challenge, but I 
don't believe the distance itself was the 
issue.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am confident that through rigorous 
training, I will overcome any challenge. 
Please continue to place your expectations 
on me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! Then, your ultimate goal is, after 
all...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Having won both the Rose Stakes and the 
Shuka Sho, I shall now challenge the title 
my mother once claimed—the Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
With a victory spanning two generations, I 
shall prove the glory of our noble 
bloodline.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Those are the words we've been waiting to 
hear. We'll be throwing our full support 
behind you as well!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...Our magazine has had the pleasure of 
working with your family since your 
grandmother's generation.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Both Grandmother and Mother achieved 
brilliant racing records truly worthy of 
being called the "Illustrious Lineage."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I cannot help but dream. That 
this young lady will surely achieve 
magnificent results as well—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: "...Isn't the pressure immense?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Carrying the legacy of my grandmother 
and mother is a source of pride, and never 
a burden... under no circumstances 
whatsoever."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"And no matter how great the expectations 
placed upon me, it is my duty to live up 
to them—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—I shall show you a trajectory worthy of 
this name, without fail.
(Clap clap clap...!)

"Daiichi Ruby's responses were so 
commanding that spontaneous applause broke 
out once the interview ended. However—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Ain't that wrong?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey! Are you holding up okay!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the vibe kinda down!? Shouldn't we 
hype it up!? Wanna sing!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Could you please explain that in a bit 
more detail?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, isn't she acting totally 
different than usual?? Like, kinda 
sad-faced?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Was that interview earlier not that 
great?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It was a good opportunity to understand 
the sheer weight of the expectations 
placed upon me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Expectations...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Having people believe in me means the 
world, and it makes me so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“Still, whenever I fail to meet those 
expectations, all sorts of thoughts start 
running through my head~”

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Are you feeling the pressure from 
everyone's expectations too, Ojo? Then why 
don'tcha just make a run for it!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Run away?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yup! A runaway sprint!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wasting time being down is so not it! 
Leave everything behind except the fun 
stuff!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sticking right with you! Even on a 
front-runner date—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, but that is quite 
enough. Any further and I shall have to 
take it as an insult.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh? Bujo...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You have your own values. That is fine. 
However, I have my own values as well.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—You and I are "different." Please do not 
ever forget that.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. I'm not really sure, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Is Ruby mad at me, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Dyuwaaaaaa~~!!
